discovery.summary: hmd-meta-types is a foundational library providing the base classes and runtime for HMD's meta-type system: entities generated from .hms type definition schema files. It ships parallel Python and TypeScript implementations of the Entity/Noun/Relationship class hierarchy, giving generated entity classes common functionality (runtime attribute type checking, serialization/deserialization to/from JSON, identifier handling, equality and hashing) regardless of how the definition file was loaded. An Extension/operation decorator mechanism lets runtime-specific behavior be merged into generated classes. It is depended on by persistence and service layers across NeuronSphere rather than run standalone.

entry_points.description: Python implementation of the Entity/Noun/Relationship base classes: attribute validation, serialize/deserialize, equality/hashing.
TypeScript implementation of Entity/Noun/Relationship, mirroring the Python base classes and factories.
Overview and worked example of how a generated entity class (e.g. from hmd-lang-* schema) extends these base classes.
Public Python package exports: Entity, Noun, Relationship.
